lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank, with the most regular spatial intervals observed in the row immediately dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible in the mid-flank region, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a semi-regular grid of higher-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-toned upper surfaces and distinct shadow-casting on their ventral-facing edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs, distributed with higher frequency toward the anterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A clear, well-defined notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin approximately mid-way between the apex and the trailing edge insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the significantly larger blobs present on the lateral flank.
